convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() calls for multiple custom indicators (XWPR_Histogram_Vol_Direct, ColorZerolagXWPR_Histogram_Vol) which are external .mqh-based or .ex5 indicators not available as built-in MT5 functions. Requires manual replication of custom indicator logic in Python.

other_exits: Reverse signal closes opposite position and opens new position in signal direction

position_sizing.conditional_logic: When Lots value is negative, treated as fixed lot size (absolute value); when positive, treated as percentage fraction of free margin for position sizing

custom_logic_notes: EA uses Exp_OnTickBar helper for new-bar detection. Entry signals derived from two custom WPR-based histogram indicators: XWPR_Histogram_Vol_Direct provides direction signals via histogram crossover of zero, and ColorZerolagXWPR_Histogram_Vol provides trend confirmation via its trend buffer. On reversal signal, existing opposite position is closed first, then new position opened. Position sizing is dual-mode: negative Lots = fixed lots, positive Lots = margin fraction. SL/TP/TrailingStop values are multiplied by 10 for 5-digit brokers (digit adjustment). Uses CTrade wrapper for order execution.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate two custom WPR histogram indicators in Python. XWPR_Histogram_Vol_Direct is a volume-weighted WPR histogram; ColorZerolagXWPR_Histogram_Vol is a zero-lag composite of multiple WPR histograms with color/trend buffers. Signal logic is zero-line crossover of histogram with trend confirmation. Digit adjustment logic for SL/TP must be handled. Dual-mode position sizing (negative=fixed, positive=margin fraction) needs careful implementation. New-bar guard prevents multiple entries per bar. Reverse-signal logic closes opposite before entering new direction.
